verdict.rationale: Claude Code's docs state that its skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which works across multiple AI tools, and Anthropic says it published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability. The agentskills.io spec defines the same folder shape (SKILL.md with YAML name/description frontmatter, plus optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ directories). A runtime probe confirmed third-party tooling (`npx skills add`) installed an official skill as a spec-conformant folder with no Anthropic account. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of the same skill folder running unmodified in a non-Anthropic agent (the probe targeted claude-code, and the Gemini port was 'adapted'), and clarity on whether Claude-specific frontmatter extensions remain portable.
